browser.ask_title: Ask the Brain about this page
browser.save_title: Save the readable part of this page into ConductLoop (marked as untrusted web content; not written into your notes folder)
browser.ask_note: Ask about this page. The page is sent as untrusted content, without tools; keys are redacted. Nothing is saved.
browser.question_ph: What does this page say about…?
browser.agent_note: Browsing agent (experimental): it opens and reads pages in its own tab. By default it is read-only. If you allow actions, it can click and type, but it asks you first for anything with an effect (forms, buying, posting, sensitive pages) and it never types passwords. You can pause it or take control at any time. Uses your BYOK key and a mandatory budget.
browser.agent_allow: Allow click and type (asks before anything with effects)
browser.not_available: The in-app browser is not available on this system.
browser.only_desktop: The browser is only available inside the ConductLoop desktop app.
browser.experimental_desc: Pages open in an isolated, private profile (nothing is kept when you close the app), with no access to ConductLoop, localhost or your LAN. No passwords are stored.
browser.no_tabs: No tabs. Type a URL above.
browser.new_tab_hint: New tab — type a URL above.
browser.blocked_local: Blocked: {host} points to a local or private address, which browser tabs cannot reach.
browser.no_provider: No AI provider is set up yet: add a key in Credentials to use the agent.
browser.no_bridge: Session created, but the browser bridge is not available (desktop app on macOS 14+ needed).
browser.agent_started: Agent session #{id} started. Its tab appears in the strip.
